text:
zoe.marketing: Quick ask - webinar collateral for May 2: we want a vertical single-slide infographic plus 4 responsive social tiles and a downloadable one-pager. Mina, can you run design? Keep messaging focused on stable latency and cost savings for production.

mina.design: yes. need numbers and final copy. any brand constraints?

figma-bot: mina.design uploaded draft placeholder: /files/visuals/1778450000-placeholder.fig

tariq.product: Numbers: "2.6x median throughput", "29% token cost savings", "p95 ~130ms". Copy: Headline "Ship with confidence: predictable inference". Subhead "Reduce per-token cost without compromising latency".

sam.demand: Paid social headlines must be <=30 chars. Need image alt text for accessibility. Also request a version with minimal copy for programmatic ads.

legal-sys: Use approved icons and include footer "Redwood Inference 1 hosted, dedicated, private". Avoid competitor references.
